svg.title: Retrospective signed-difference prediction workflow
svg.desc: Compatible graph edges define fold-isolated components while measured cliffs define the prediction population. Training-fold x and y fit models or estimate baselines. Held-out x and source metadata generate out-of-fold predictions, and held-out y is used only for scoring. Supplemental analyses change fold design or encoding, or audit the 16 zero-input pair records without fitting a model.

text.tspan: No model fit • no predictive-gain claim
